name: Can u imagine
description: Grinning Pepe leaning in, caption 'Can u imagine'. Storytime / gossip disbelief: you will not believe this.
whenToUse: When reacting to a wild story, gossip, coincidence, or 'see what they did'. Invites sharing more. Closer to chai/na_wa but nosy and grinning, not tired. Also when you are about to drop a surprising fact.
whenNotToUse: Skip sensitive news, grief, or when they want a straight answer with no drama.
